description: openIO-Canada builds multiregional environmentally extended input-output tables for Canada's 13 provinces and territories. Its README describes reference years 2014–2022, 492 commodities, greenhouse gases, pollutants, mineral resources, water consumption, energy use and plastic waste, with EXIOBASE links for imports. Users choose source tables and modelling options, including capital endogenisation; outputs are provincial economic and environmental footprints. Geographic coverage is Canada and its modelled external value chains. `LICENSE.md` states CC BY-SA 4.0 for this work; EXIOBASE input rights remain separate. A material limitation is that the README warns of large mining-sector errors with several newer EXIOBASE versions and recommends avoiding them. Provincial averages also cannot stand in for an individual plant. openIO-Canada can test industrial, road-building and energy-transition supply-chain scenarios. The related Brightway catalogue platform is a different life-cycle analysis system. No EXIOBASE tables or code archive were downloaded.
inputs: Canadian supply-use tables, extensions and compatible EXIOBASE version
name: openIO-Canada provincial EEIO model
notes: G7 G7-1832. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
